meta.title: Spreading Grass
meta.description: A bush of toxic herbs is born from sunlight and grows in the soil. But the world was what ravaged it and made it ambitious.

units.rawText: The darkness ebbs away, like a tide receding to reveal hidden shores. The sound of my heartbeat thumps louder, faster. My eyelids feel impossibly heavy, but I manage to lift them—only for an unfamiliar face to suddenly fill my vision.
units.displayText: The darkness ebbs away, like a tide receding to reveal hidden shores. The sound of my heartbeat thumps louder, faster. My eyelids feel impossibly heavy, but I manage to lift them—only for an unfamiliar face to suddenly fill my vision.

units.rawText: I do not recognize her.
units.displayText: I do not recognize her.

spans.text: I do not recognize her.

units.rawText: Urgh. My head hurts... What happened? I remember I was on a call with Sangoma...

units.rawText: <cmdr>, I have a favor to ask. It might be a little bit dangerous, but there's no one else I can trust for this.

spans.text: , I have a favor to ask. It might be a little bit dangerous, but there's no one else I can trust for this.

units.rawText: Really now, the almighty Sangoma needs my help? I'm all ears.
units.displayText: Really now, the almighty Sangoma needs my help? I'm all ears.

spans.text: Really now, the almighty Sangoma needs my help? I'm all ears.

units.rawText: I'm happy that you're agreeing so readily, but let me walk you through the details first.
units.displayText: I'm happy that you're agreeing so readily, but let me walk you through the details first.

spans.text: I'm happy that you're agreeing so readily, but let me walk you through the details first.

units.rawText: Here's the situation: there's a kid in the Guardians who I'm currently supervising—or perhaps cultivating is a better word for it—who has been sticking close to me during my time in Arcadia.
units.displayText: Here's the situation: there's a kid in the Guardians who I'm currently supervising—or perhaps cultivating is a better word for it—who has been sticking close to me during my time in Arcadia.

spans.text: Here's the situation: there's a kid in the Guardians who I'm currently supervising—or perhaps cultivating is a better word for it—who has been sticking close to me during my time in Arcadia.

units.rawText: My resignation from Arcadia has left her confused, prompting her to request permission from Boss to take on assignments at the Oasis.
units.displayText: My resignation from Arcadia has left her confused, prompting her to request permission from Boss to take on assignments at the Oasis.

spans.text: My resignation from Arcadia has left her confused, prompting her to request permission from Boss to take on assignments at the Oasis.

units.rawText: So she's your friend? I can arrange for someone to take her in.
units.displayText: So she's your friend? I can arrange for someone to take her in.

spans.text: So she's your friend? I can arrange for someone to take her in.

units.rawText: It probably won't be that simple... Lil' Bella is just like Bonneville—she hates humans.
units.displayText: It probably won't be that simple... Lil' Bella is just like Bonneville—she hates humans.

spans.text: It probably won't be that simple... Lil' Bella is just like Bonneville—she hates humans.

units.rawText: As for how far her hatred goes... how do I put it? She doesn't even respect Boss. Every few days, she mixes deadly nightshade, aconite, and oleander into Boss' cup.
units.displayText: As for how far her hatred goes... how do I put it? She doesn't even respect Boss. Every few days, she mixes deadly nightshade, aconite, and oleander into Boss' cup.

spans.text: As for how far her hatred goes... how do I put it? She doesn't even respect Boss. Every few days, she mixes deadly nightshade, aconite, and oleander into Boss' cup.

units.rawText: Lil' Bella believes you tricked me into joining the Oasis, which, in her eyes, is akin to the most heinous multi-level marketing cult in all of Magrasea.
units.displayText: Lil' Bella believes you tricked me into joining the Oasis, which, in her eyes, is akin to the most heinous multi-level marketing cult in all of Magrasea.

spans.text: Lil' Bella believes you tricked me into joining the Oasis, which, in her eyes, is akin to the most heinous multi-level marketing cult in all of Magrasea.

units.rawText: Ah, my apologies. We, the Oasis, are most certainly the epitome of evil.
units.displayText: Ah, my apologies. We, the Oasis, are most certainly the epitome of evil.

spans.text: Ah, my apologies. We, the Oasis, are most certainly the epitome of evil.

units.rawText: I might be an old model, yes, but she should know that I'm not that gullible. She's just being overprotective.
units.displayText: I might be an old model, yes, but she should know that I'm not that gullible. She's just being overprotective.

spans.text: I might be an old model, yes, but she should know that I'm not that gullible. She's just being overprotective.

units.rawText: Anyway, I still need to help Panakeia with her new medicine. Please take care of Lil' Bella for me when she arrives.
units.displayText: Anyway, I still need to help Panakeia with her new medicine. Please take care of Lil' Bella for me when she arrives.

spans.text: Anyway, I still need to help Panakeia with her new medicine. Please take care of Lil' Bella for me when she arrives.

units.rawText: She's a good kid, but really bullheaded. If she ends up stuck, please give her a nudge. She's in your hands now~
units.displayText: She's a good kid, but really bullheaded. If she ends up stuck, please give her a nudge. She's in your hands now~

spans.text: She's a good kid, but really bullheaded. If she ends up stuck, please give her a nudge. She's in your hands now~

units.rawText: "A good kid"? I glance down at myself, bound tightly like a ham ready for roasting. Honestly, it's hard to associate the person who did this with anything resembling goodness.
units.displayText: "A good kid"? I glance down at myself, bound tightly like a ham ready for roasting. Honestly, it's hard to associate the person who did this with anything resembling goodness.

spans.text: "A good kid"? I glance down at myself, bound tightly like a ham ready for roasting. Honestly, it's hard to associate the person who did this with anything resembling goodness.

units.rawText: My body remains half-paralyzed. I attempt to move, but the bindings are too tight to allow even the slightest change in posture.
units.displayText: My body remains half-paralyzed. I attempt to move, but the bindings are too tight to allow even the slightest change in posture.

spans.text: My body remains half-paralyzed. I attempt to move, but the bindings are too tight to allow even the slightest change in posture.

units.rawText: Hah... Y-You're the... Lil' Bella... Sangoma talked about?
units.displayText: Hah... Y-You're the... Lil' Bella... Sangoma talked about?

spans.text: Hah... Y-You're the... Lil' Bella... Sangoma talked about?

units.rawText: So you're awake. Much quicker than I expected. You can refer to me like Sangoma does, but since it's our first meeting, I think you should start from zero, Professor.
units.displayText: So you're awake. Much quicker than I expected. You can refer to me like Sangoma does, but since it's our first meeting, I think you should start from zero, Professor.

spans.text: So you're awake. Much quicker than I expected. You can refer to me like Sangoma does, but since it's our first meeting, I think you should start from zero, Professor.

units.rawText: The nickname "Lil' Bella" seems to have made you lower your guard against me. Don't make the same mistake again, or you won't even have the chance to regret it, hehe~
units.displayText: The nickname "Lil' Bella" seems to have made you lower your guard against me. Don't make the same mistake again, or you won't even have the chance to regret it, hehe~

spans.text: The nickname "Lil' Bella" seems to have made you lower your guard against me. Don't make the same mistake again, or you won't even have the chance to regret it, hehe~

units.rawText: My name is Belladonna. You'd best remember it well; it's simply good manners.
units.displayText: My name is Belladonna. You'd best remember it well; it's simply good manners.

spans.text: My name is Belladonna. You'd best remember it well; it's simply good manners.

units.rawText: You know that I'm the Professor, so I assume you've done your homework on me, Miss Belladonna. Still, tying someone up isn't exactly how I'd define having good manners.
units.displayText: You know that I'm the Professor, so I assume you've done your homework on me, Miss Belladonna. Still, tying someone up isn't exactly how I'd define having good manners.

spans.text: You know that I'm the Professor, so I assume you've done your homework on me, Miss Belladonna. Still, tying someone up isn't exactly how I'd define having good manners.

units.rawText: That's what makes this exciting. Don't you feel by now that your fate rests firmly within my grasp?
units.displayText: That's what makes this exciting. Don't you feel by now that your fate rests firmly within my grasp?

spans.text: That's what makes this exciting. Don't you feel by now that your fate rests firmly within my grasp?

units.rawText: She lifts the syringe gingerly as if offering a hint, a sardonic smile framing her mocking inflection that reverberates low and menacingly from her throat. The thick, acrid scent of chemicals encompasses her as she paces closer, and my mind once again descends into chaos.
units.displayText: She lifts the syringe gingerly as if offering a hint, a sardonic smile framing her mocking inflection that reverberates low and menacingly from her throat. The thick, acrid scent of chemicals encompasses her as she paces closer, and my mind once again descends into chaos.

units.rawText: I just gave you a little injection of some "mildly harmful" medicine. Don't worry, Professor, I have the antidote with me.
units.displayText: I just gave you a little injection of some "mildly harmful" medicine. Don't worry, Professor, I have the antidote with me.

spans.text: I just gave you a little injection of some "mildly harmful" medicine. Don't worry, Professor, I have the antidote with me.

units.rawText: I want to play a game. If you can entertain me, I'll give you the antidote.
units.displayText: I want to play a game. If you can entertain me, I'll give you the antidote.

spans.text: I want to play a game. If you can entertain me, I'll give you the antidote.

units.rawText: But if you upset me... well, your soul shall find release from your body, not with a triumphant shout, but a pitiful whimper.
units.displayText: But if you upset me... well, your soul shall find release from your body, not with a triumphant shout, but a pitiful whimper.

spans.text: But if you upset me... well, your soul shall find release from your body, not with a triumphant shout, but a pitiful whimper.

units.rawText: I specifically told Florence to tone it down... and here we are. Seems like her habit of injecting others with nondescript chemicals has passed on to someone else.
units.displayText: I specifically told Florence to tone it down... and here we are. Seems like her habit of injecting others with nondescript chemicals has passed on to someone else.

spans.text: I specifically told Florence to tone it down... and here we are. Seems like her habit of injecting others with nondescript chemicals has passed on to someone else.

units.rawText: I don't know what you mean by that, but please, tell me your choice.
units.displayText: I don't know what you mean by that, but please, tell me your choice.

spans.text: I don't know what you mean by that, but please, tell me your choice.

units.rawText: Choose carefully, Professor, or you might really die here.
units.displayText: Choose carefully, Professor, or you might really die here.

spans.text: Choose carefully, Professor, or you might really die here.
But I refuse.

options.rawText: The only winning move is to play.
options.displayText: The only winning move is to play.

spans.text: The only winning move is to play.

units.rawText: Miss Belladonna, there are many doors to attain an antidote. Don't forget that we're at the Oasis.
units.displayText: Miss Belladonna, there are many doors to attain an antidote. Don't forget that we're at the Oasis.

spans.text: Miss Belladonna, there are many doors to attain an antidote. Don't forget that we're at the Oasis.

units.rawText: Soon, others will notice my absence, and the medical department will find the cure. I need not comply.
units.displayText: Soon, others will notice my absence, and the medical department will find the cure. I need not comply.

spans.text: Soon, others will notice my absence, and the medical department will find the cure. I need not comply.

units.rawText: The Doll's soft pink eyes dim, replaced by an ominous blood-red hue. Driven by madness, she strides forward, her hand seizing my face and locking my gaze with hers, while thorned vines coil around my body.
units.displayText: The Doll's soft pink eyes dim, replaced by an ominous blood-red hue. Driven by madness, she strides forward, her hand seizing my face and locking my gaze with hers, while thorned vines coil around my body.

spans.text: The Doll's soft pink eyes dim, replaced by an ominous blood-red hue. Driven by madness, she strides forward, her hand seizing my face and locking my gaze with hers, while thorned vines coil around my body.

units.rawText: The thorns dig into my skin, their poison seeping into my veins. It leaves me gasping for air as a sharp pain courses through my nerves. But before I can cry out in agony, her voice wavers unexpectedly.
units.displayText: The thorns dig into my skin, their poison seeping into my veins. It leaves me gasping for air as a sharp pain courses through my nerves. But before I can cry out in agony, her voice wavers unexpectedly.

spans.text: The thorns dig into my skin, their poison seeping into my veins. It leaves me gasping for air as a sharp pain courses through my nerves. But before I can cry out in agony, her voice wavers unexpectedly.

units.rawText: Liars... you humans think yourselves so righteous when you're nothing but liars...
units.displayText: Liars... you humans think yourselves so righteous when you're nothing but liars...

spans.text: Liars... you humans think yourselves so righteous when you're nothing but liars...

units.rawText: (Ugh... This is not going to end so easily.)
units.displayText: Ugh... This is not going to end so easily.

spans.text: Ugh... This is not going to end so easily.

units.rawText: It's not like you're going to release me if I say no...
units.displayText: It's not like you're going to release me if I say no...

spans.text: It's not like you're going to release me if I say no...

units.rawText: My life may be cheap, but I can't throw it away just yet. The Oasis' future still lies on it.
units.displayText: My life may be cheap, but I can't throw it away just yet. The Oasis' future still lies on it.

spans.text: My life may be cheap, but I can't throw it away just yet. The Oasis' future still lies on it.

units.rawText: So I'll play your game.
units.displayText: So I'll play your game.

spans.text: So I'll play your game.

units.rawText: She may be the very embodiment of death, cold and untouchable, but there's a loneliness in her eyes that speaks of something she longs for me to fulfill. I need to know what it is that she seeks from me.
units.displayText: She may be the very embodiment of death, cold and untouchable, but there's a loneliness in her eyes that speaks of something she longs for me to fulfill. I need to know what it is that she seeks from me.

spans.text: She may be the very embodiment of death, cold and untouchable, but there's a loneliness in her eyes that speaks of something she longs for me to fulfill. I need to know what it is that she seeks from me.

units.rawText: Hehe... Excellent. Now that you've agreed to play, you'd better listen carefully to my instructions from now on.
units.displayText: Hehe... Excellent. Now that you've agreed to play, you'd better listen carefully to my instructions from now on.

spans.text: Hehe... Excellent. Now that you've agreed to play, you'd better listen carefully to my instructions from now on.

units.rawText: Let's begin while we're in a great mood, shall we? Ding-dong, now I'll tell you a story, Professor, a story about me in the real world.
units.displayText: Let's begin while we're in a great mood, shall we? Ding-dong, now I'll tell you a story, Professor, a story about me in the real world.

spans.text: Let's begin while we're in a great mood, shall we? Ding-dong, now I'll tell you a story, Professor, a story about me in the real world.

units.rawText: In this story, you'll play the role of another Professor working at Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute. Let's just call her "Prof. F." for now.
units.displayText: In this story, you'll play the role of another Professor working at Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute. Let's just call her "Prof. F." for now.

spans.text: In this story, you'll play the role of another Professor working at Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute. Let's just call her "Prof. F." for now.

units.rawText: Then, you'll answer three questions, each occurring in a different situation, and you'll do so honestly and willingly.
units.displayText: Then, you'll answer three questions, each occurring in a different situation, and you'll do so honestly and willingly.

spans.text: Then, you'll answer three questions, each occurring in a different situation, and you'll do so honestly and willingly.

units.rawText: I'll give you the antidote if I find your answers acceptable~
units.displayText: I'll give you the antidote if I find your answers acceptable~

spans.text: I'll give you the antidote if I find your answers acceptable~

units.rawText: Understood. Let's get started.
units.displayText: Understood. Let's get started.

spans.text: Understood. Let's get started.

units.rawText: Don't be so hasty. To help you immerse yourself fully in the story, I'll administer a specialized drug that will make you experience it as if it were reality.
units.displayText: Don't be so hasty. To help you immerse yourself fully in the story, I'll administer a specialized drug that will make you experience it as if it were reality.

spans.text: Don't be so hasty. To help you immerse yourself fully in the story, I'll administer a specialized drug that will make you experience it as if it were reality.

units.rawText: Relax, it'll feel like a small prick. It won't hurt~
units.displayText: Relax, it'll feel like a small prick. It won't hurt~

spans.text: Relax, it'll feel like a small prick. It won't hurt~

units.rawText: What's the marking rubric for your questions? Or is it just whatever suits your fancy?
units.displayText: What's the marking rubric for your questions? Or is it just whatever suits your fancy?

spans.text: What's the marking rubric for your questions? Or is it just whatever suits your fancy?

units.rawText: Yes.
units.displayText: Yes.

spans.text: Yes.

units.rawText: If so, then figuring out what you fancy might be more crucial than following the story.
units.displayText: If so, then figuring out what you fancy might be more crucial than following the story.

spans.text: If so, then figuring out what you fancy might be more crucial than following the story.

units.rawText: My, I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I happen to be someone who hates being pandered to.
units.displayText: My, I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I happen to be someone who hates being pandered to.

spans.text: My, I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I happen to be someone who hates being pandered to.

units.rawText: Her smile dims in a flash, a clear exemplification of her unstable mental state.
units.displayText: Her smile dims in a flash, a clear exemplification of her unstable mental state.

spans.text: Her smile dims in a flash, a clear exemplification of her unstable mental state.

units.rawText: She places heavy emphasis on the final words of her sentence. Then, I feel the sharp sting of a needle piercing my neck, and in an instant, my world flips upside down.
units.displayText: She places heavy emphasis on the final words of her sentence. Then, I feel the sharp sting of a needle piercing my neck, and in an instant, my world flips upside down.

spans.text: She places heavy emphasis on the final words of her sentence. Then, I feel the sharp sting of a needle piercing my neck, and in an instant, my world flips upside down.

units.displayText: ...So this is where it begins?

units.rawText: A few years ago, I was transferred to Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute immediately after I had been manufactured.
units.displayText: A few years ago, I was transferred to Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute immediately after I had been manufactured.

spans.text: A few years ago, I was transferred to Ultilife's Third Bio-Pharmaceutical Institute immediately after I had been manufactured.

units.rawText: As the girl speaks, her story weaves its way into my mind. The drug takes hold, and my consciousness is dragged into her words, falling into a vast, cold expanse of pure white.
units.displayText: As the girl speaks, her story weaves its way into my mind. The drug takes hold, and my consciousness is dragged into her words, falling into a vast, cold expanse of pure white.

units.rawText: The Doll they just sent in was of exceptionally poor quality. The data and reports generated by the Doll showed significant discrepancies when compared to clinical trial results.
units.displayText: The Doll they just sent in was of exceptionally poor quality. The data and reports generated by the Doll showed significant discrepancies when compared to clinical trial results.

spans.text: The Doll they just sent in was of exceptionally poor quality. The data and reports generated by the Doll showed significant discrepancies when compared to clinical trial results.

units.rawText: Some reagents are highly toxic and can cause irreversible damage to the human body if not handled with care.
units.displayText: Some reagents are highly toxic and can cause irreversible damage to the human body if not handled with care.

spans.text: Some reagents are highly toxic and can cause irreversible damage to the human body if not handled with care.

units.rawText: Yeah. Otherwise, we wouldn't be using Dolls for this. Ethics and the weight of public opinion continue to hang over our heads.

units.rawText: Ah, right. Is the Doll behind you the new one they're putting through the wringer?
units.displayText: Ah, right. Is the Doll behind you the new one they're putting through the wringer?

spans.text: Ah, right. Is the Doll behind you the new one they're putting through the wringer?

units.rawText: Oh, that thing? No. She's an assistant pharmacist Doll Professor F commissioned. The Professor should still be there. I'll bring her in...

units.rawText: I hear a knock at the door. Still feeling dazed, I slowly gather my thoughts. When I finally come to, I see a green screen reflecting my image—a haggard middle-aged woman stares right back at me. She was clearly a scholar, what with the lab coat she dresses in.

units.rawText: I'm seeing the world through someone else's eyes, yet I have no power to influence it with my own will. It feels eerily like a dream, one where I am utterly powerless to take control.

units.displayText: Come in.

units.displayText: A young researcher brings in a Doll that looks like a young girl into the office.

units.displayText: Professor, I've brought the UL-Toxic in.

spans.text: Professor, I've brought the UL-Toxic in.

units.displayText: The girl's eyes reveal a trace of anxiety as she stands silently behind the researcher. Unlike the other Dolls sent to the research facility, her clothing is unusually thin.

units.rawText: You're not wrong. Yes, the results must be accurate. Indeed, if there's any error in the data, all of our efforts will be wasted.

units.rawText: UL-Toxic, starting today, you will serve as my assistant. I believe your database holds more knowledge than I've accumulated in my entire life, and perhaps, one day, you may even replace me.
units.displayText: UL-Toxic, starting today, you will serve as my assistant. I believe your database holds more knowledge than I've accumulated in my entire life, and perhaps, one day, you may even replace me.

units.rawText: But as a newly manufactured Doll, there's still much for you to learn. Would you like me to be your mentor? I'll do my best to share all of my experiences with you.
units.displayText: But as a newly manufactured Doll, there's still much for you to learn. Would you like me to be your mentor? I'll do my best to share all of my experiences with you.

spans.text: But as a newly manufactured Doll, there's still much for you to learn. Would you like me to be your mentor? I'll do my best to share all of my experiences with you.

units.rawText: Ex... periences?
units.displayText: Ex... periences?

spans.text: Ex... periences?

units.rawText: Yes, human knowledge should never be kept behind closed doors due to selfishness. I'm happy to share my experiences, even if they may seem worthless.
units.displayText: Yes, human knowledge should never be kept behind closed doors due to selfishness. I'm happy to share my experiences, even if they may seem worthless.

units.rawText: Professor's experiences... are not worthless.
units.displayText: Professor's experiences... are not worthless.

spans.text: Professor's experiences... are not worthless.

units.rawText: The speaker's true intention was to prevent contamination of the samples, yet the listener would likely interpret it warmly, as though saying, "I don't want to see you harmed."
